title: End-to-End Historical Music Restoration in Latent Space
abstract: arXiv:2610.00607v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Historical music restoration (HMR) has almost exclusively focused on constrained problems such as Super-Resolution or the restoration of solo pieces, under-exploring the general task of restoring orchestral historical music, which has multiple instruments. This under-exploration is largely because the HMR domain, early-20th-century recordings, has no pre-degradation ground-truth pairs, making the restoration task unsupervised and more challenging. This paper presents a supervised end-to-end orchestral HMR benchmark by exploring both the synthetic degradation functions and the end-to-end generative deep-learning restoration methods. We simulate the historical recording degradation chain more faithfully than prior work, which makes orchestral restoration into a tractable supervised problem. A latent flow-matching model trained on the resulting synthetic pairs outperforms existing HMR baselines on intrusive, non-intrusive, and subjective

translated_title: 潜空间中的端到端历史音乐修复
translated_abstract: 历史音乐修复（HMR）几乎仅局限于超分辨率或独奏曲目修复等受限问题，而对修复包含多种乐器的管弦乐历史音乐这一更一般的任务探索不足。这种探索不足主要是因为HMR领域所处理的对象——20世纪初的录音——不存在退化前的真实参考配对数据，使得修复任务成为无监督问题，难度更大。本文通过探索合成退化函数和端到端生成式深度学习修复方法，提出了一个有监督的端到端管弦乐历史音乐修复基准。我们比以往工作更忠实地模拟了历史录音的退化链，从而将管弦乐修复转化为一个可处理的有监督问题。在所得合成配对数据上训练的潜空间流匹配模型，在有损指标、无损指标和主观评价上均优于现有的HMR基线方法。
tldr: 该论文通过更忠实地模拟历史录音退化链，构建了首个有监督的端到端管弦乐历史音乐修复基准，并在其上训练潜空间流匹配模型，在多种客观与主观指标上超越了现有方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a supervised end-to-end benchmark for orchestral historical music restoration by faithfully simulating the historical recording degradation chain, and a latent flow-matching model trained on the synthetic pairs outperforms existing HMR baselines on objective and subjective metrics.
